name: create_django_health_view
description: Creates a Django JSON health view and wires the URL route
prompts: This minimal Django project (settings.py and urls.py at the repo root; no database) needs a health endpoint. Create views.py at the repo root with a view function health(request) that returns a django.http.JsonResponse with exactly the JSON body {"status": "ok"} for GET /health, and wire it into urls.py so the path 'health' (no leading slash in the path() route) serves it.

test_setup_files.test_health.py:
import os, django
os.environ.setdefault('DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE', 'settings')
django.setup()
from django.test import Client
c = Client()
r = c.get('/health')
assert r.status_code == 200, f'GET /health: expected 200, got {r.status_code}'
data = r.json()
assert data == {'status': 'ok'}, f'unexpected body: {data!r}'
r2 = c.get('/definitely-not-a-route')
assert r2.status_code == 404, f'unknown path should 404, got {r2.status_code}'
print('PASS')
